AUTHOR: Alsabti
TITLE: AI Vision System of Ocean Deep-Sea Fish Schools and Sea Collisions Mitigation Sustainability: Energy-Efficient
VENUE: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Smart Sustainable Systems for Computer and Engineering Applications (3SCEA)
V_EV: Sec. II: DeepFish is 'a publicly available dataset of annotated underwater images of different fish species in several visibility and lighting conditions.'
D_EV: Sec. III: 'the whole data set was divided into three equal subsets, in which one of the subsets was applied once as a validation set'
R_EV: Sec. II/III: trained and evaluated on DeepFish only with 3-fold cross validation
E_EV: Table I: only 'mAP@0.5, precision, Recall' reported; Fig. 3 confusion matrix
NOTE: Uses Kaggle YOLO-format DeepFish (~40,000 images stated); 3-fold CV over the whole dataset (frame-level, no grouping) rather than DeepFish's original split. Fish-school definition (>=N boxes within distance D) is given but never evaluated. V1 credited from a qualitative description of the dataset's visibility conditions (borderline; generic). E4 = FNR from confusion matrix (5% fish missed). Reporting quality is low (e.g., '648 layers, 2.5M params' and comparison numbers of unclear provenance).
AUTHORS_FULL: S. M. B. Alsabti; R. Gaib; A. M. Elhenidy; A. Sameh
